name: eth-gas-watch
author: sparkleware
description: Ethereum gas-price status check on a schedule — traffic-light status against a configurable gwei threshold, logs price history.
long_description_md:
## What it does

Queries Etherscan's gas oracle every few hours, prints Safe / Standard / Fast gwei, classifies with 🟢 (cheap) / 🟨 (moderate) / 🔴 (high) relative to a `${var}` gwei threshold (default 20), and appends each reading to `memory/logs/gas-watch.log` for searchable price history.

## Why

Gas spikes are the #1 friction for on-chain ops. A scheduled glance lets you batch transactions during cheap overnight / weekend windows instead of reactively paying peak rates.

## How it works

Single `curl` to Etherscan's `gasoracle` endpoint (no API key required for casual cadence; optional `ETHERSCAN_API_KEY` env var raises the rate limit). Parsed with `jq`. Classification is plain integer comparison on the standard-tier gwei value.

All read — no on-chain writes, never spends gas. Default schedule is every 4 hours.
